summary: Implemented every stub in tinydb/queries.py: _generate_test (path resolution, ValueError on empty path, hash handling), the exists/matches/search/test/any/all/one_of/noop/map methods and the where() shorthand, and added the missing is_cacheable() and fragment() members. The last full-suite run showed 63 passed and 138 failed, with the failures in other builders' files (database, table, utils), while tests/test_queries.py passes 32 of 32.
